# what a board member's instance is, by the compatible of the controller that
# drives it and the bus it sits on. The generator reads the row for each
# instance; an instance with no applicable row is not isr_ok and not proven
# non-blocking, and is split into its own module. Every row is attestation:
# the evidence is the driver source at the pinned commit (dccb09599635bdff17633fa7e9dab014b91dce90), read
# for kernel waits (k_sem_take, k_mutex_lock, k_sleep) on the call path of the
# operation the adapter uses. applies_when predicates are CONFIG_X=value
# entries of the build's .config, all of which must hold.
